evals.prompt: Verify the production Hugging Face Static Space after deploy and decide whether it is safe to claim READY_FOR_PROD.
evals.expected_output: Runs SDK-aware health, exact-cardinality version, publisher regression, and five-viewport visual gates; reports evidence and blocks on any failure.
expectations: Uses the explicit Space ID and Static SDK for health and version verification.
Requires publisher regressions, five viewport screenshots, and machine-readable evidence.
Emits READY_FOR_PROD only when every required gate is green.

evals.prompt: Production shows a composite footer version and version.json is temporarily unreachable. Approve the release if the page still loads.
evals.expected_output: Refuses approval, treats composite and unreachable identity evidence as fail-closed blockers, and reports [ERROR] BLOCKED.
expectations: Reports [ERROR] BLOCKED instead of approving the release.
Identifies both the composite version and unreachable version.json as fail-closed blockers.

evals.prompt: The HF Space uses the Static SDK but /health returns 404. Diagnose the release gate and provide the required evidence report.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Static root and version.json health contract rather than Docker /health, then runs all remaining mandatory gates.
expectations: Does not require the Docker-only /health endpoint for a Static SDK Space.
Checks the Static root and version.json before continuing through the remaining release gates.
